kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed contract's public baseToken equals the _baseToken argument passed to initialize; the mutant that force-sets baseToken to address(0) will violate this for any non-zero _baseToken.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with reversed assignment that sets baseToken to the zero address instead of the provided _baseToken.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's stored changeFee equals the _changeFee argument passed (i.e., changeFee == _changeFee); the mutant doubles the stored value so it violates this property for inputs where _changeFee != 0.
kills.change_summary: Replace assigning changeFee with assigning _changeFee * 2 (double changeFee during initialize).

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's public baseToken getter returns the _baseToken argument passed to initialize; the mutant wrongly sets baseToken to the nft argument for some inputs, breaking this invariant.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assignment that sets baseToken to nft address (swap) instead of the provided _baseToken.

kills.property: For any callers and any _feeRate input within allowed bounds, calling initialize(...) sets the contract's public feeRate to the provided _feeRate; the mutant sets feeRate to 0 instead, so there exist inputs where c.feeRate() != _feeRate after initialize.
kills.change_summary: Set feeRate to zero instead of the provided _feeRate (replace assignment feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = 0;).

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed contract's public feeRate equals the _feeRate argument given to initialize; the mutant assigns feeRate from _changeFee instead and thus can make feeRate != _feeRate for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Assign feeRate from changeFee (replace feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = uint16(_changeFee % 65536);) causing different stored feeRate value.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed pool's baseToken equals the provided _baseToken (reference); the mutant erroneously sets baseToken to the factory address, so there exist inputs for which c.baseToken() != _baseToken.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assignment that sets baseToken to factory address instead of the provided _baseToken.

kills.property: After initialize(...) completes, the contract's nft() getter returns the same address that was passed as the _nft argument; the mutant breaks this by setting nft to address(0) instead of the provided value for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to nft so initialize sets nft to address(0) instead of the provided _nft argument.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's nft getter returns the nft address argument passed to initialize (i.e. c.nft() == _nft); the mutant that assigns nft = msg.sender breaks this by making c.nft() != _nft for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to nft so initialize sets nft to msg.sender instead of the provided _nft argument.

kills.property: After any initialize(...) call that succeeds, the contract's public changeFee equals the _changeFee parameter passed to initialize (reference); the mutant increments and thus will make changeFee != _changeFee for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assigning changeFee with assigning changeFee+1 (increment changeFee during initialize).

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's public changeFee equals the _changeFee argument passed (the reference sets changeFee = _changeFee); the mutant that forces changeFee to 0 will violate this when _changeFee != 0.
kills.change_summary: Replace assigning changeFee with assigning zero (force changeFee to 0 during initialize).
